{"tool": "bash", "input": {"command": "cd /tmp
# edge cases
touch empty
python3 -c "open('p64','wb').write(b'B'*64)"
python3 -c "open('p1G','wb').write(b'C'*(1<<20))"
for f in empty p64 p1G /dev/zero /proc/self/status /tmp; do
  /tmp/vuln "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1; V=$?
  /tmp/fixed "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1; F=$?
  echo "file=$f vuln=$V fixed=$F"
done
# also check binary disassembly to confirm the 999 compare is against <=64
objdump -d /tmp/vuln | grep -A3 -B1 '3e7\|999' | head -20"}}
